LanguageData.ABY_CrownInterdictor.label: Crown Interdictor
LanguageData.ABY_CrownInterdictor.description: A compact lockframe blade built to turn repeated precise contact into a local prohibition. The first strike writes a target-specific writ. The second fixes the same hostile body inside a short Crown edict, slowing its movement and degrading the clean combat rhythm it thought it still possessed.
